articles.title: Keir Starmer: Schachmatt an der Macht

articles.image_title: Keir Starmer: LONDON, ENGLAND - MAY 11: Prime Minister Keir Starmer gives a speech at Coin Street Community Centre on May 11, 2026 in London, England. Prime Minister and Labour Leader Keir Starmer is making a major speech in a bid to secure his premiership, following the devastating losses the Labour Party suffered in last week's elections. Starmer says the government "will face up to the big challenges" the country faces after Labour relinquished nearly 1500 seats in local elections across England and power in the Welsh Senedd. In the wake of Labour's historic losses, Labour MP Catherine West has said she will attempt to trigger a leadership contest against Starmer if his cabinet ministers fail to challenge him. (Photo by Carl Court/Getty Images)

articles.title: Lieferstopp für Öl aus Kasachstan: Beschäftigungsgarantie für Raffinerie in Schwedt wird verlängert

articles.image_title: Lieferstopp für Öl aus Kasachstan: A general overview taken on April 30, 2026 shows an entry gate to the PCK refinery, which supplies oil to Berlin and the surrounding region, in Schwedt, northeastern Germany. Germany has learned that Russia plans to halt the flow of Kazakh oil through the Druzhba pipeline to the PCK refinery in eastern Germany starting May 1, 2026 the energy ministry in Berlin told AFP on April 22, 2026. The move comes amid Russia's war against Ukraine and a global energy crisis linked to the US-Israeli war against Iran, which has caused major disruptions to global oil and gas markets. The PCK refinery near the Polish border supplies much of the Berlin region with fuel, but the German energy ministry voiced confidence the impact would be limited. (Photo by Tobias SCHWARZ / AFP via Getty Images)
